goal: Add an explicit Ejecutar/Re-ejecutar button to WeightingCountryListRow's Acciones column, matching Calibración's list-view Calibrar button pattern.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The Pesaje list view shows an 'Ejecutar' button (no prior runs) or 'Re-ejecutar' button (has a completed run, not currently processing) in the Acciones cell for every row; clicking it opens WeightingDetailModal, same as clicking the row.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: WeightingCountryListRow.test.tsx new cases asserting the button renders with the right label and opens the dialog. Playwright: e2e/weighting.spec.ts list-view case clicks the button and asserts the config dialog opens.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clicking the Ejecutar/Re-ejecutar button does not also trigger the history modal, and does not cause the row's own onClick to double-fire (single dialog open).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: assert only one WeightingDetailModal open call / dialog instance after the click (stopPropagation correctness).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WeightingCountryCard.tsx (Tarjetas view) behavior is unchanged — no new button added there, hint text and existing action row untouched.
No regressions: full vitest suite, eslint, tsc -b green; e2e smoke green.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b; MOCK_SERVER_PORT=<port> npx playwright test --project=smoke

tasks.desc: Add Ejecutar/Re-ejecutar Button to WeightingCountryListRow.tsx's Acciones TableCell, labeled 'Ejecutar' when no latestRun else 'Re-ejecutar' (hidden while isProcessing, since the Procesando/Detener pair already occupies that state), onClick stopPropagation + openDetail. Add/extend vitest coverage in WeightingCountryListRow.test.tsx.
Extend e2e/weighting.spec.ts (or add a Pesaje list-view case) with a Playwright smoke assertion that the button opens the config dialog in list view.
